Container.Name: NextDash
Container.Overview: A lightweight, self-hosted bookmark dashboard that features a minimalist, keyboard-driven interface with extensive customization options, making it the perfect personal dashboard for power users. Based on the excellent ThinkDashboard.
Container.Requires: Docker/self-hosted deployment. No external database required — data is stored locally in the mapped AppData path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bookmarks dashboard homelab keyboard-driven self-hosted startpage
Container.Changes:
### 2026.08.29 - v1.4.x - Added: Archiving and local page preservation - Added: Widgets (Archive, Trash, Blind Spots, Duplicates, Backups) - Added: Custom widgets (sonarr, sabnzbd, speed-tracker and 23 more!) - Added: New import sources (like raindrop, netscape and more..) - Added: Webhooks and MCP support - Fixed: Security and correctness issues found in static analysis
### v1.3.x - Added: Dead-link detection
